anchor_note: anchor = ground point under the head axis; airborne frames are already raised by lift_px

cruise_back.note: Board points along travel (fixes sideways skate_back). Subtle sway.

cruise_back_left.note: Board along travel; near-static sway (5 close variants).

cruise_back_right.note: Board along travel; near-static sway (4 close variants).

push_back.note: 6 frames composited from two generations. Push foot touches the ground beside the deck in frames 2-3; from behind the push reads but is subtle; pushing foot side is ambiguous.

push_back_left.note: 5-step cycle, 4 unique drawings: ride, lift, ground contact, extension, recover. Keys came from a separate 2-frame generation.

push_left.note: Clean side push, back foot plants and extends with speed lines.

push_right.note: Clean side push; frame 5 extension with speed lines.

push_front.note: Push reads; angle drifts toward front_left (same drift as v1).

walk_back.note: Board under left arm (viewer's left), alternating steps.

walk_front.note: Board under left arm; leg alternation is small.

walk_left.note: Generator kept repeating one stride; stride and passing keys from a 2-frame render give some up-down rhythm but legs do not truly alternate.

walk_right.note: Small leg variation only; the passing-key render was rejected (marching knee).

kickup_back.note: Ride, step off, tail stomp, board up, catch, tuck. Strip frames 5-6 rejected (turned to camera / wrong arm) and replaced by a 2-frame catch render.

dropin_back.note: Board drops pointing away; step-on; roll.

kickup_front.note: Replaces weak v1 kickup_1: tail press, board kicked up, catch, tuck.

kickup_left.note: Frames 4-5 rejected (two boards drawn). 4 frames: jumps from tail-tip to tucked.

dropin_left.note: Frame 3 of the strip had no character (board only), dropped.

ollie_back.note: Strip crouch/land frames drew the board sideways and were replaced by cruise_back frames; air frames show the board at ~45 degrees.

kickflip_back.note: Board rotates through edge and upside-down.

grab_back.note: Frame 1 had no board, frame 6 sideways board: both rejected. 4 air frames.

ollie_front.note: Crouch, pop, rise, peak, descend, land.

kickflip_front.note: Board flip reads; board sits low under feet in frame 1.

ollie_left.note: Strict profile. Strip frame 6 (sitting) rejected; frame 5 is the landing.

ollie_right.note: Strict profile; jump height is modest.

ollie_front_left.note: From a rejected side-view try that came out front-left; usable as a front-left ollie.

grind_back.note: Board along the rail, sparks. try1 (sideways board) rejected.

grind_left.note: Profile 50-50 with sparks and arm balance.

bail_back.note: Strip frame 4 turned to camera, rejected. Board in last frame lies sideways.

bail_front.note: Single sit-down pose salvaged from a rejected try.

rejected.push_back_left_strip_try1/try2 as push: feet never leave the board; reused as cruise_back_left and lift frames
rejected.push_back_right_strip_try1/try2 as push: feet never leave the board; reused as cruise_back_right and lift frames
rejected.kickup_back_strip_try1 idx4,5: turned to camera; board under the wrong arm
rejected.ollie_back_strip_try1 (all) and try2 idx: board drawn sideways on the ground
rejected.grind_back_strip_try1: board sideways for a grind going away
rejected.ollie_left_strip_try1 as left: came out front-left; salvaged as ollie_front_left + bail_front
rejected.ollie_right_strip_try1: came out front/three-quarter with a sitting frame
rejected.kickup_left_strip_try1, dropin_left_stri: came out front view (duplicate of front strips)

atlas.note: atlas_rect is the trimmed frame; anchor_offset is that rect's top-left relative to the shared ground anchor, in atlas pixels (y down).
